mapper.select: SELECT id, fleet_no, name FROM fleet WHERE enabled=1 ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id, name FROM sys_user WHERE id IN #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dify_agent_draft(id, actor_id, action, payload, expires_at) VALUES(#{id}, #{actorId}, #{action}, #{payload}, #{expiresAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, actor_id, action, payload, expires_at, result FROM dify_agent_draft WHERE id=#{id} AND actor_id=#{actorId} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE dify_agent_draft SET result=#{result}, payload=NULL WHERE id=#{id} AND result IS NULL
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dify_agent_draft WHERE expires_at<#{before} LIMIT 100
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT b.id, b.partition_date, b.synced_at FROM alert_archive_outbox o JOIN alert_archive_batch b ON b.id=o.batch_id AND b.synced_at IS NOT NULL WHERE ORDER BY b.synced_at, b.id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT (SELECT MAX(synced_at) FROM alert_archive_batch) AS latest_batch_synced_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM alert_archive_outbox o LEFT JOIN alert_archive_batch b ON b.id=o.batch_id WHERE AND b.synced_at IS NULL) AS pending_events, EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM alert_archive_backfill WHERE id=1 AND last_id>=through_id) AS backfill_complete
